mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers investor concerns about weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in residential construction permits (HOUST) below 1,000,000 units, combined with a decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS), indicates a collapse in housing and consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to recessionary expectations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST < 1000.0 and RSAFS < 370000.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (2017=100) for three consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, which increases the probability of corporate earnings deterioration and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 100.0 for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate positive Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 215.0 with a 12-month growth rate exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts or initiate tightening, which increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and 12-month growth > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based collapse in aggregate demand, which increases the likelihood of a recession and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS < 370000.0 and INDPRO < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 jobs per month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.4%), indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS < 50000 and UNRATE > 5.4% (t-test p > 0.05), or the interaction signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.04 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized growth, observed over two consecutive quarters, signals a deepening economic slowdown, which increases the probability of earnings downgrades and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized for two quarters (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal has a Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
